approved: 2026-10-16 user approval of the readiness-review data decisions

rationale.positives: Signer-grouped: per source, round(0.2 x signers) signers (lowest SHA-256 rank of seed:signer) form CAL; a source with fewer than 3 signers stays wholly FIT because one signer cannot be split. DEV signers are excluded by construction.
rationale.negatives: Participant-grouped. Approved: N0 P03/P04 for training, P05/P06 as the held-out false-activation set (suite v03). P1 and N0 participants P01/P02 follow one role each so CAL negatives are participant-disjoint from FIT. Each N0 participant used a distinct phone and environment, so the split is also device/environment-disjoint. P1 (hands-visible non-sign) has only P01 (19 rows) and P02 (26 rows); the larger, P02, is FIT so fitting keeps the most real hand-movement negatives.
rationale.phone_design_signer: The only phone positive signer; all attempts stay FIT, so CAL has no phone-domain positives (a stated limitation).

outside_this_split: R3b design-signer TRAIN capture (added as FIT when it exists)
